mostWorthwhile.text: Making the capillary bed was most worthwhile because it showed where oxygen and nutrients leave the blood and carbon dioxide moves toward it.

leastWorthwhile.text: The extra vein-lining step was least worthwhile: I expected the pictured valves to fit the wall directly, although the hint made the prerequisite clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the venous wall needed a lining before the valves could be added. The later picture also clarified how muscle compression and the valves work together.

arbitrary.text: The lining prerequisite was not obvious to me when I tried the valves, but it did have a visible purpose once shown.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the connected route and seeing how its parts have different jobs made me curious about what comes next.
